proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and ALEC memberships, and decision-making oversight.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the Board believes that a special report beyond Chevron's current voluntary and mandatory disclosures is an unnecessary and inefficient use of Chevron's resources.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Business with Conflict-Complicit Governments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating the feasibility of adopting a policy of not doing business with governments complicit in genocide or crimes against humanity.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because Chevron has in place rigorous policies and processes to identify and manage geopolitical and socioeconomic issues and risks.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Climate Change Stress Testing and Scenario Impact
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual assessment of long-term portfolio impacts to 2035 under plausible climate change scenarios, including the IEA 450 Scenario.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because we believe that the report "Managing Climate Change Risks: A Perspective for Investors"

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Report on Transition to a Low Carbon Economy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing feasibility of altering the energy mix by divesting high carbon-risk assets or acquiring low carbon or renewable energy businesses.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because we believe such a report is unnecessary in light of the safeguards and oversight in place through Chevron's strategy, planning and risk management processes.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Independent Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the Board believes that stockholder interests are best served when Directors have the flexibility to determine the best person to serve as Chairman

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Independent Director with Environmental Expertise
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that at least one board candidate be recommended who has high environmental expertise and qualifies as independent under specified criteria.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the Board believes that its current membership possesses significant environmental experience

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Special Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment giving holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowners meeting without shareowner-only conditions.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because stockholders have consistently supported Chevron's current By-Law regarding special meetings
